user.title: Connect to TrueNAS
user.description: Use an API key from a read-only account (Credentials → Users, in the Read-Only Administrator group). TrueNAS 25.10 or newer. HTTPS only: TrueNAS revokes API keys sent over plain HTTP.

data.verify_ssl: Check the HTTPS certificate (untick for TrueNAS's default self-signed one)

reauth_confirm.title: New API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: TrueNAS refused the saved key. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the NAS. Check the address and HTTPS port.
error.ssl_error: The certificate couldn't be verified. If you use TrueNAS's self-signed certificate, untick the certificate check.
error.https_only: Use the address without http://. API keys must only be sent over HTTPS.
